chapter: Life in Columbus and recent activity
title: 1970s tours with Barry Martyn and freelance concerts

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: Well let's see, you mentioned that you had been still travelling on the road a good deal. What kind of work did you do during the '70s? Besides Jonah?
Besides Jonah, all these things with Barry Martin.
Yeah, let's talk about that, we didn't get that on the tape at all.
Who is a drummer in England.

Yes, yes, and then he's sponsoring, he is the manager and promoter of these European tours. And I did a couple of those since I been away from Jonah. And different things on my own, up in Canada I did a little skit up there about five or six days, concerts on my own, where there's a band right there. And I just work with them and sit in, I mean I just sit in with the local band.

Oh up around Vancouver, up in Calgary, Winnipeg, Montreal, Toronto. And of course Los Angeles. So I've been doing quite a bit of just free lancing concerts on my own. And I just did one up in--say, Evalene, where did I do that gig in, upstate? Grosse Pointe, Ann Arbor, Michigan.
A club there. Some fellow...gets groups and brings in individual artists.
